what: Reliance is the largest metals service centre company in North America. It buys steel, aluminium and specialty metals from mills, processes them to customer specification, and delivers small orders quickly from hundreds of locations.
customers: Manufacturers, fabricators and construction contractors needing cut-to-size metal in small quantities and short timeframes.
money: carbon steel, aluminium, stainless and specialty metals
moat: Hundreds of locations holding diverse inventory, which lets it fill small urgent orders that mills will not take, at margins mills cannot earn.
risks: Metal prices drive revenue and gross margin per tonne
Revenue has fallen about 6% a year over three years
opportunities: Return on invested capital of 9% with low debt and consistent buybacks
Its small-order, quick-turnaround model holds margins better than mills in downturns
watch: Tons sold and gross profit per ton.
